sections.overview: Sminthopsis macroura is an Australian dasyurid marsupial.
sections.identification: A dark stripe runs down its face, giving it its common name.
sections.habitat: It occurs in dry habitats, including desert, dune, grassland and savanna.
sections.diet: It eats insects and may also take small vertebrates such as lizards and mice.
sections.behavior: It is mainly nocturnal and terrestrial, sheltering in burrows or nests made from grasses and leaves.
sections.reproduction: Breeding details reported by the source come from captive colonies, so they should not be treated as a field calendar.
sections.ecology: Its tail fat provides an energy reserve when food becomes scarce.
sections.conservation: The Mammal Diversity Database lists the species as Least Concern globally.
